cellContent: Inline text, formatting, hard breaks and semantic atoms; no nested blocks

typedConversion.trigger: Enter at the collapsed end of the third top-level text-only paragraph

newline.paragraph: Shift+Enter and Alt+Enter use structural paragraph splitting
newline.tableCell: Shift+Enter falls back to a hard break when structural splitting declines
newline.appleControlEnter: Hard break outside code; exit to a new paragraph from code

nativeKeyOwnership: Document keymaps own handled Enter/Escape; declined native keys reach the owning application route even when browser defaults are suppressed
layout: Content-width editor tables and scrollable submitted tables use top-aligned wrapping cells, explicit alignment and horizontal row separators
clipboardHtml: Rich table structure, spans and semantic atom identities are retained
markdown: One value per authored cell, pipe escaping, inline marks, hard-break tags, column alignment and padding
